title: Detail schemas
description: data/schemas.json, schema 1.1 -- every connection detail drawn in Woodcore's «Schémas» tab, as lib/calc-engine.typ's show-schema reads it (docs/domain/connections.md §3.3quinquies; plan 3 of je-souhaite-commencer-generic-valley.md). Generated by calc/domains/schema.py, never hand-edited. Coordinates are millimetres, x right and z down -- the connections' own frame -- so that a connector or a moment-polaire calculation can place its own arrows over this same drawing with no conversion.

schema_version.description: -- 1.1, or 1.2 where a schema carries `texts` (issue #43): an export written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

label.description: Free text, printed after the schema's id in the figure's caption.

source.description: details/<id>.json, the source it was exported from.

style.description: What the figure was drawn with: the drawing's own three factors -- the strokes, the symbols placed on a point, the texts -- 1 where the source states none (v0.99). The plans' and the static models' records already carry theirs, and a record saying what the figure was drawn with is the convention every other placed value here follows. Nothing in the report reads it: it is what lets one export be read against another when a slider has moved.

figures.description: The drawing, once per language a report can be written in (docs/typst/language.md §4bis): a legend or a connector's kind may carry a word. One frame per language for the same reason data/connections/ and data/statics/ have one: a longer sentence in one language must not widen another's.

file.description: schemas/<id>-<lang>.svg under data/, the drawing the report sets.

elements.description: Every piece the drawing shows, so that a halo may mark one and a connector calculation may read its position and its section.

position.description: The Positions Element row this piece is a detail of; absent where it names none.

b.description: Its breadth in mm as the drawing was made with it (v0.75): stated on the element or followed from its position; null where neither gives one.

b_from.description: 'stated', 'position', or '' where the side is unknown.

h.description: Its height in mm as the drawing was made with it (v0.75): stated on the element or followed from its position; null where neither gives one.

h_from.description: 'stated', 'position', or '' where the side is unknown.

width.description: A linear element only: the band it is drawn at, in mm -- the side of its section its view shows, or schema.ELEMENT_DEFAULT_WIDTH while that side is unknown.

at.description: Its points, [x, z] in mm, at least two.

label.description: What is written on the piece: its own label, or its position, strength class and section -- «T001 C24 100/200».

style.description: The factors this entry stated over the drawing's, where it stated any -- absent for one that follows the drawing, which is every entry of a schema that uses none. A factor and never a size (see the source's own schema): what it holds is what was multiplied into the drawing's own three when this entry was drawn.

connectors.description: Every fastener marker the drawing shows -- what a *Connecteurs* or *Moments polaires* calculation checks a subset of by id ("fasteners").

diameter.description: mm, where the marker states one; absent otherwise.

style.description: The factors this entry stated over the drawing's, where it stated any -- absent for one that follows the drawing, which is every entry of a schema that uses none. A factor and never a size (see the source's own schema): what it holds is what was multiplied into the drawing's own three when this entry was drawn.

aids.description: Every aid the drawing shows -- only a 'centre' or a 'point' by default, a line only where its source marks it `shown`.

line.description: A line-shaped aid's two drawn ends, [[x, z], [x, z]], clipped to the figure's frame.

style.description: The factors this entry stated over the drawing's, where it stated any -- absent for one that follows the drawing, which is every entry of a schema that uses none. A factor and never a size (see the source's own schema): what it holds is what was multiplied into the drawing's own three when this entry was drawn.

dimensions.description: Every dimension written on the figure -- statics.schema.json's own shape, taken as-is.

show.description: What the figure writes beside it: 'none', 'name', 'value' or 'name+value' (schema.dimension_show). Additive: a record without it wrote `text` all the same.

text.description: What the figure writes, by `show`; '' for nothing.

style.description: The factors this entry stated over the drawing's, where it stated any -- absent for one that follows the drawing, which is every entry of a schema that uses none. A factor and never a size (see the source's own schema): what it holds is what was multiplied into the drawing's own three when this entry was drawn.

labels.description: Every id the schema carries -- what `highlight` may name.

unresolved.description: An element whose `position` no longer names a row of Positionen.xlsx, as '<element>: <why>'. A warning at the export, never a reason to stop the report (docs/decisions.md §13's v0.33 rule).

texts.description: The texts placed with the Text tool (issue #43): what each printed. Absent where the drawing has none.

text.description: Its token text, as the source holds it.

lines.description: Its lines as printed, every token replaced by its variable.

links.description: Where each variable it printed came from (REQ-012).

origin.description: 'formulas' for a domain of the «Formules» tab, whose id is `instance`; absent for the export.

stale.description: True where the variable could not be read and its last value was printed (D-06).
